title: Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-9)
about: Depression screening: nine questions scored 0 to 27. The answers can be typed into OpenEMR's PHQ-9 encounter form (enable it under Administration > Forms > Forms Administration).

licence.terms: No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute.
licence.permission: None needed: the statement printed on the instrument.

blocks.label: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
items: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself, or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite: being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

blocks.text: If you are thinking about hurting yourself, tell a staff member now. If you are in danger, call your local emergency number.

Published severity (Kroenke 2001): 5 or more, mild; 10 or more, moderate; 15 or more, moderately severe; 20 or more, severe depression. A total of 10 or more found major depression with 88% sensitivity and 88% specificity.
If question 9 is answered above "Not at all", or is left blank, a clinician asks about it the same day, before the patient leaves. If the patient has already left, contact them today.
